setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A new, empty project with the transport stopped and nothing assigned to a channel. The pattern editor from chapter 1 is on screen. Channel 1 has no output chosen yet and no tempo has been set; the rest of the course uses MIDI port 1, MIDI channel 1 for channel 1.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then turn E1 right three detents. The title row reads CHANNEL TASKS with CH01: a list of the pages of channel 1, each marked OPEN >, with the footer Channel Editor. This list is how you reach every channel page (Masks, Trig params, Output, Clock, Merge modes, Merge Shape, Harmony, Device and History).
steps.title: Open Channel tasks

steps.caption: Turn E2 down the list to Device, the eighth task (seven detents below Masks), and press K3. The title row reads DEVICE with CH01. Only the Device row is listed, set to None: the MIDI channel and MIDI port rows appear once you choose a device.
steps.title: Open Device

steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent to choose the first entry after None, CC Device (a generic MIDI device). DEVICE CH01 now lists Device CC Device, MIDI channel CC1, MIDI port OUT 1 and Device locks RESET, and the last line reads Press K3 to confirm: this is only a draft, the channel still has no output and K2 would cancel it.
steps.title: Choose CC Device (draft)

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply the draft. The Press K3 to confirm line is replaced by OK, and notes from channel 1 now leave on MIDI port 1, MIDI channel 1. With your own gear, choose its device entry and set its port and channel; with no external gear, choose Polyperc 1 for the norns voice.
steps.title: Choose a device and apply it

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), turn E1 right one detent to Song tasks, turn E2 to Tempo & feel and press K3, then turn E2 up to Tempo. GLOBAL FEEL for SONG 01 lists Tempo, Swing type and Swing, and Tempo shows the norns clock tempo; in this recording it already reads 90, the value every timing in the chapters ahead assumes. On your norns it may read something else, such as 120.
steps.title: Open Tempo

steps.caption: Tempo moves one BPM per detent between 30 and 300, with no coarse step. To see it work, turn E3 left or right and watch the number follow, then bring it back to 90 and press K3 to apply. GLOBAL FEEL shows Tempo 90, which makes a beat exactly 2/3 s for every timing in the chapters ahead.
steps.title: Set the tempo to 90
